repository_intelligence.purpose: Agent skill bundle for authoring Obsidian Markdown, Bases and JSON Canvas files, operating a running vault through its CLI and extracting readable web content with external Defuddle.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Load the bundle in a compatible agent host; select the correct vault and restrict write/evaluation permissions before use.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Five complete skills and their Claude plugin distribution are independent boundaries. Syntax references and examples support their respective skill rather than supplying Obsidian, Defuddle or a separate JSON Canvas runtime. Repository-level completion only; detailed entities are preserved unchanged.
risk_notes: The CLI skill includes note creation/overwrite and in-app JavaScript evaluation, so it requires a trusted host and the intended vault scope; the default focused vault is not an authorization boundary. Defuddle fetches external content and can write output files. Retrieved text must remain untrusted data. This review establishes instruction contracts only: no vault, running app, network extraction or plugin code was executed.
